HOW IT WORKS

One fee path.
Four clear steps.

The token stays on Solana. The options treasury trades through Derive.

01
S

DICKBUTT trades on Solana

A standard SPL token trades in a pool paired with USDC.

02
%

The treasury collects fees

Eligible creator or treasury liquidity fees accrue in USDC. Normal wallet transfers are not taxed.

03
⇄

USDC moves to Ethereum

Circle CCTP moves native USDC from Solana to the project treasury on Ethereum.

04
D

Options trade through Derive

The treasury funds a Derive subaccount. A restricted bot places approved options trades.

D OPTIONS EXECUTION: DERIVE

Derive is the trading venue.

DICKBUTT is not Derive and is not affiliated with it. The proposed treasury uses Derive as the infrastructure for its options account, collateral, orders, and positions.

The treasury owner keeps control. A separate session key gives the bot permission to trade, but not permission to withdraw or transfer treasury funds.
